name: Photo Collection
description: Per-profile photographic records keyed by subject id: first capture, personal-best score, best capture reference, and themed collection sets. It listens only to scored captures, so an arbitrary screenshot cannot advance gameplay. Replaying the same capture id is idempotent, and a lower-scoring repeat never replaces a personal best. The collection stores metadata and capture references, not image blobs; file storage belongs to the host platform. This is not a species dex: one subject may have many photographs, quality matters, and a subject can remain in the collection without being seen, caught, or owned by any other system.

inputs.name: subjectCatalog
inputs.description: Photographable subject definitions: id, display metadata, and collection tags. Runtime samples may reference only configured subjects, making completion mean 'of this configured catalog'.

inputs.name: photoSets
inputs.description: Optional themed sets: id, ordered subject ids, and display metadata. Sets may overlap; completion is evaluated independently for each set.

inputs.name: personalBestMinimumDelta
inputs.description: Minimum score improvement required to replace a best record and emit a personal-best event. Prevents floating-point noise from producing repeated notifications.

inputs.name: processedCaptureCacheSize
inputs.description: Bounded recent-capture id cache used to suppress duplicate deliveries within a session. Persisted subject and best records remain authoritative across reloads.

outputs.name: entries
outputs.description: Subject id to first-capture metadata, best score, best capture reference, and capture count.

outputs.name: setProgress
outputs.description: Set id to {captured, total, complete}, computed from unique subjects rather than total shutter presses.

outputs.name: completionFraction
outputs.description: Unique photographed subjects divided by configured catalog size, or 0 for an empty catalog.
